# UDreamUIWidgetGeometryLibrary

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from `UBlueprintFunctionLibrary`.

Declared in `Public/DreamUIWidgetGeometryLibrary.h`.

Coordinate conversions between a widget's own space, the viewport and the screen -- this
framework's USlateBlueprintLibrary.

Everything returns bool and writes its answer through an out-parameter, where UMG's equivalents
return the value directly. That is deliberate and it is about world-space UI: a panel welded to a
machine in the level has no viewport position until a camera is pointed at it, and the honest
answers are "here it is" and "nowhere", not a number computed in the wrong space. A caller that
ignores the bool gets a zero, not a lie that looks like a position.

## Functions

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bool AbsoluteToLocal(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InAbsoluteCoordinate, FVector2D& OutLocalCoordinate)` | pure | A viewport pixel position, in the widget's own space. Assumes the point lies in the widget's plane. |
| `bool AbsoluteToViewport(UObject* WorldContextObject, FVector2D InAbsoluteCoordinate, FVector2D& OutPixelPosition, FVector2D& OutViewportPosition)` | pure | Viewport pixels, as both pixels and DPI-scaled viewport coordinates. UMG's AbsoluteToViewport. |
| `bool GetAbsoluteSize(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D& OutAbsoluteSize)` | pure | The widget's size in viewport pixels. False when the rect cannot be placed in the viewport. |
| `FVector2D GetLocalSize(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry)` | pure | The widget's size in its own units. Zero for a geometry that names no widget. |
| `FVector2D GetLocalTopLeft(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry)` | pure | The corner local coordinates are measured from, in the widget's own space. |
| `FDreamUIWidgetGeometry GetWidgetGeometry(UDreamWidget* InWidget)` | pure | Read a widget's geometry -- UMG's GetCachedGeometry, GetTickSpaceGeometry and GetPaintSpaceGeometry all at once. |
| `bool IsUnderLocation(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InAbsoluteCoordinate)` | pure | Is a viewport pixel position inside this widget's rect? UMG's IsUnderLocation. |
| `bool LocalToAbsolute(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InLocalCoordinate, FVector2D& OutAbsoluteCoordinate)` | pure | A point in the widget's own space, in viewport pixels. |
| `bool LocalToViewport(UObject* WorldContextObject, FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InLocalCoordinate, FVector2D& OutPixelPosition, FVector2D& OutViewportPosition)` | pure | A point in the widget's own space, as both viewport pixels and DPI-scaled viewport coordinates -- UMG's LocalToViewport, which hands back both for the same reason. |
| `bool ScreenToViewport(UObject* WorldContextObject, FVector2D InScreenPosition, FVector2D& OutViewportPosition)` | pure | A screen position as DPI-scaled viewport coordinates. UMG's ScreenToViewport. |
| `bool ScreenToWidgetAbsolute(FVector2D InScreenPosition, FVector2D& OutAbsoluteCoordinate)` | pure | The same screen position in viewport pixels. Here the two are the same space, so this is identity. |
| `bool ScreenToWidgetLocal(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InScreenPosition, FVector2D& OutLocalCoordinate)` | pure | A screen position -- what a mouse position or a world-to-screen projection gives you -- in the widget's own space. UMG's ScreenToWidgetLocal. |
| `bool TransformScalarAbsoluteToLocal(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, float InAbsoluteScalar, float& OutLocalScalar)` | pure | Transform Scalar Absolute to Local |
| `bool TransformScalarLocalToAbsolute(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, float InLocalScalar, float& OutAbsoluteScalar)` | pure | A LENGTH converted between the two spaces, with no origin involved -- UMG's Scalar_LocalToAbsolute and friends. |
| `bool TransformVectorAbsoluteToLocal(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InAbsoluteVector, FVector2D& OutLocalVector)` | pure | Transform Vector Absolute to Local |
| `bool TransformVectorLocalToAbsolute(FDreamUIWidgetGeometry InGeometry, FVector2D InLocalVector, FVector2D& OutAbsoluteVector)` | pure | A DIRECTION and length, per axis. UMG's Vector_LocalToAbsolute. |

## Compared with UMG

Every Blueprint-facing member of the UMG class, and where it went. *adopt*: same name, same meaning. *map*: here under another name or on another type. *reject*: deliberately absent, with the reason.

| UMG | Member | Status | Here | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `IsUnderLocation` | adopt | `IsUnderLocation` | Against the widget's measured pixel rect. False for a geometry with no viewport position at all -- a render-target canvas, a world-space one with no camera. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `AbsoluteToLocal` | adopt | `AbsoluteToLocal` | Assumes the point lies in the widget's own plane, which is true of every 2D interface. Returns false for a canvas whose scaler cannot be inverted -- world space above all, where the raycaster is the right tool. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `LocalToAbsolute` | adopt | `LocalToAbsolute` | Local has its origin at the widget's BOTTOM-left, not Slate's top-left: every other normalized coordinate in this framework already puts zero at the bottom left. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `GetLocalTopLeft` | adopt | `GetLocalTopLeft` | Always zero, because local coordinates are defined from that corner -- the same answer UMG gives for an ordinary widget. Kept so a graph written against UMG reads the same. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `GetLocalSize` | adopt | `GetLocalSize` |  |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `GetAbsoluteSize` | adopt | `GetAbsoluteSize` | Measured from the rect's two projected corners, so a canvas scaler, a render scale and an ancestor's scale are all already in it. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `Scalar_AbsoluteToLocal` | map | `TransformScalarAbsoluteToLocal` | Named for what it transforms rather than with a type prefix. The wider axis decides for a non-uniformly scaled widget, as in UMG. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `Scalar_LocalToAbsolute` | map | `TransformScalarLocalToAbsolute` |  |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `Vector_AbsoluteToLocal` | map | `TransformVectorAbsoluteToLocal` | Per axis, so a non-uniform scale is honoured here where the scalar version has to pick one. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `Vector_LocalToAbsolute` | map | `TransformVectorLocalToAbsolute` |  |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `EqualEqual_SlateBrush` | map | `UDreamUIWidgetLibrary::EqualEqual_DreamUIImageBrush` | This framework's brush is FDreamUIImageBrush, so the node is named for it. Exact on the floats rather than tolerant: the question a caller asks with == is 'did anybody change this brush', and a near-comparison would answer no to a one-pixel nudge. The node lives on the widget library because the other brush verbs do. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `LocalToViewport` | adopt | `LocalToViewport` | Hands back both the pixel position and the DPI-scaled one, as UMG does. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `AbsoluteToViewport` | adopt | `AbsoluteToViewport` |  |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `ScreenToWidgetLocal` | adopt | `ScreenToWidgetLocal` | No bIncludeWindowPosition parameter: a screen position and a viewport pixel position are the same space here, because the framework draws inside the viewport and never against the desktop. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `ScreenToWidgetAbsolute` | adopt | `ScreenToWidgetAbsolute` | Identity, for the reason on the row above. It exists so a ported graph keeps its shape and so the equivalence is stated somewhere. |
| `USlateBlueprintLibrary` | `ScreenToViewport` | adopt | `ScreenToViewport` |  |
